headings.usage_rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings > 32px. Use font-black for major section headers, font-light for elegant numerical data. Never use Inter or standard sans for headings.

body.usage_rules: Strictly use for readable form elements, table data, and standard paragraph text. Clean, geometric, authoritative.

mono.usage_rules: Use for the 30-minute timer, registration numbers, and code-like data.

colors.rules: No pure black or pure white except for primary action buttons. Use tinted greys. Do NOT use gradients. Rely on high contrast boundaries.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards) & Centered Narrow Column (For Forms)

surface_styles.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 border-b border-border/40 sticky top-0 z-50

visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: radius-sm (2px) to radius-md (4px) maximum. Keep it sharp, academic, and structured.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. Focus on 1px borders instead of heavy shadows for separation.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only on the sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85) with a delicate 1px bottom border. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or 2px radius. High contrast (black bg, white text). Hover state MUST be clearly defined (e.g. hover:bg-black/80).
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border. Focus ring must be stark black (focus:ring-black focus:border-black).
components.forms: Multi-step form uses Framer Motion for smooth horizontal or fade-in transitions between steps.
components.tables: Dense, clean. Use Shadcn Table. No zebra striping, just subtle bottom borders. Hover state on rows.
components.toasts: Use Sonner component for all notifications. Place at bottom-right.
components.timer: A distinctive visual element for the 30-min wait. Use JetBrains Mono, red accent color when < 5 mins, soft pulse animation.

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95). Subtle translate-y on hover for dashboard cards.
motion.form_steps: Slide left-to-right with opacity fade when advancing preference forms.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA. All text > 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add descriptive data-testid to every button, form input, tab, and row.

images.description: Minimal abstract white concrete stairs. Use as a very subtle, low-opacity background or hero image on the landing page to evoke calm structure amidst chaos.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Build the Landing Page with a clear, empathetic message and a large primary CTA for 'I couldn't poll'.
Implement the 30-minute waiting logic in the student flow. Show a visually distinct timer. After 30 mins, unlock the email magic-link input.
Create the multi-step form: Step 1 (Details), Step 2 (Elective Category), Step 3 (Preferences 1, 2, 3 for N electives).
Build a clean tabular faculty dashboard to review submissions, assign courses, and trigger allocation emails.
Ensure all Shadcn components (forms, tables, dialogs) are styled sharply to match the Swiss Brutalist/Academic theme.
Do NOT center align text globally. Left-align for reading efficiency.
Do NOT use gradients. Rely on typography scale and borders for hierarchy.
Add 'data-testid' to all critical elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic outputs. Apply generous spacing (p-6, p-8). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure focus states are accessible. NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Sonner for toasts.
